readings.subsection: The Structural Guarantee of the Tablets
readings.title: The Second Tablets and the Acacia Ark
readings.subtitle: Moses prepares the physical vessel and stones for YeHoVaH to rewrite the foundational Constitution.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 10:1] “At that time <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Hew for yourself <dn>את</dn> two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to <dn>Me</dn> on the mountain. And you shall make yourself an ark of wood,</dq> [2] <dq>then <dn>I</dn> write on the tablets <dn>את</dn> the Words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. And you shall put them in the ark.’</dq> [3] “So I made an ark of acacia wood, hewed two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain, with the two tablets in my hand. [4] “And <dn>He</dn> wrote on the tablets according to the first writing, <dn>את</dn> the Ten Words, which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had spoken to you in the mountain from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly. Then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave them to me, [5] and I turned and came down from the mountain, and put <dn>את</dn> the tablets in the ark which I had made. And they are there, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded me.”

readings.title: The Journey and Aharon's Death
readings.subtitle: The physical transition of priestly authority to El‛azar amidst the journey to the land of rivers.
readings.text: [6] Now the children of Yisra’ěl set out from the wells of Beněi Ya‛aqan to Mosěrah. Aharon died there, and he was buried there. And El‛azar his son became priest in his place. [7] From there they set out to Guḏgoḏah, and from Guḏgoḏah to Yotḇathah, a land of rivers of water.

readings.title: The Exclusive Separation of Lěvi
readings.subtitle: The tribe of Lěvi is severed from terrestrial inheritance to bear the weight of YeHoVaH's Kavod and serve Him exclusively.
readings.text: [8] At that time <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> separated <dn>את</dn> the tribe of Lěvi to bear <dn>את</dn> the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to serve <dn>Him</dn>, and to bless in <dn>His</dn> Name, to this day. [9] Therefore Lěvi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is his inheritance, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> promised him.

readings.title: The Forty Days and the Departure
readings.subtitle: Following Moses' intercession, YeHoVaH commands the assembly to advance and possess the guaranteed inheritance.
readings.text: [10] “And I stayed in the mountain for forty days and forty nights. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> heard me at that time also, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chose not to destroy you. [11] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Arise, go before the people, to set out, and let them go in and possess <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>I</dn> swore to their fathers to give them.’</dq>

readings.title: The Demand for Absolute Emunah
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH requires complete functional trust, calling Israel to sever the stubbornness of their hearts and walk in His ways.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 10:12] “And now, Yisra’ěl, what is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> asking of you, but to fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, to walk in all <dn>His</dn> ways and to love <dn>Him</dn>, and to serve <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> with all your heart and with all your being, [13] to guard <dn>את</dn> the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> laws which I command you today for your good? [14] “See, the heavens and the heaven of heavens belong to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, also the earth with all that is in it. [15] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> delighted only in your fathers, to love them. And <dn>He</dn> chose their seed after them, you above all peoples, as it is today. [16] “And you shall circumcise <dn>את</dn> the foreskin of your heart, and harden <dn>את</dn> your neck no more.

readings.title: Impartial Justice for the Vulnerable
readings.subtitle: The great and awesome Elohim demonstrates His strict, impartial justice by providing for the fatherless, widow, and stranger.
readings.text: [17] “For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn> of mighty ones and Master of masters, the great <dn>Ěl</dn>, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality nor takes a bribe. [18] “<dn>He</dn> executes right-ruling for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the stranger, giving him food and a garment. [19] “And you shall love <dn>את</dn> the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Mitsrayim.

readings.title: The Guarantee of Multiplication
readings.subtitle: A command to cling strictly to YeHoVaH, who transformed seventy souls into a nation as numerous as the stars.
readings.text: [20] “Fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. Serve <dn>Him</dn>, and cling to <dn>Him</dn>, and swear by <dn>His</dn> Name. [21] “<dn>He</dn> is your praise, and <dn>He</dn> is your <dn>Elohim</dn>, who has done for you these great and awesome deeds which your eyes have seen. [22] “Your fathers went down to Mitsrayim with seventy beings, and now <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has made you as numerous as the stars of the heavens.

readings.title: Remembering the Crucible of Mitsrayim
readings.subtitle: Moses appeals to the generation who witnessed YeHoVaH's mighty judgments upon Mitsrayim and the internal rebellion.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:1] “And you shall love <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and guard <dn>His</dn> charge: even <dn>His</dn> laws, and <dn>His</dn> right-rulings, and <dn>His</dn> commands, always. [2] “And you shall know today – for it is not your children who have not known and who have not seen <dn>את</dn> the discipline of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>His</dn> greatness, <dn>His</dn> strong hand and <dn>His</dn> outstretched arm, [3] and <dn>His</dn> signs, and <dn>His</dn> works which <dn>He</dn> had done in the midst of Mitsrayim, to Pharaoh sovereign of Mitsrayim, and to all his land; [4] and that which <dn>He</dn> had done to the army of Mitsrayim, to their horses and their chariots, when <dn>He</dn> made <dn>את</dn> the waters of the Sea of Reeds overflow them as they pursued you, and how <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has destroyed them to this day; [5] and what <dn>He</dn> had done for you in the wilderness till you came to this place; [6] and what <dn>He</dn> had done to Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, son of Re’uḇěn, when the earth opened <dn>את</dn> its mouth and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the living creatures that were in their possession, in the midst of all Yisra’ěl. [7] “For yours are the eyes that saw all the great work of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, which <dn>He</dn> did.

readings.title: A Land Dependent on the Heavens
readings.subtitle: Unlike the human-engineered irrigation of Mitsrayim, the promised inheritance relies directly on YeHoVaH's provision of rain.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:8] “And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> every command which I command you today, so that you are strong, and shall go in, and shall possess <dn>את</dn> the land which you are passing over to possess, [9] and to prolong your days in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> swore to give your fathers, to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey. [10] “For the land which you are going in to possess is not like the land of Mitsrayim from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and watered it by foot, as a vegetable garden, [11] but the land which you are passing over to possess is a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water from the rain of the heavens, [12] a land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> looks after. The eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the latter end of the year.

readings.title: The Link Between Obedience and Rain
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH establishes a direct environmental response to the nation's spiritual fidelity or idolatry.
readings.text: [13] And it shall be that if you diligently obey <dn>My</dn> commands which I command you today, to love <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and to serve <dn>Him</dn> with all your heart and with all your being, [14] <dq>then <dn>I</dn> shall give you the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, and you shall gather in your grain, and your new wine, and your oil.</dq> [15] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be satisfied.</dq> [16] Guard yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other mighty ones and bow down to them. [17] Then the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall burn against you, and <dn>He</dn> shall shut up <dn>את</dn> the heavens, and there be no rain, and the land not give its increase. And you shall perish quickly from the good land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is giving you.

readings.title: Internalizing the Master Architecture
readings.subtitle: The strict command to bind the laws to the body and integrate them into the daily rhythm of the household.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:18] And you shall lay up <dn>את</dn> these Words of <dn>Mine</dn> in your heart and in your being, and shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes. [19] And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up, [20] and shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates, [21] so that your days and the days of your children are increased on the soil of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens on the earth.

readings.title: The Promise of Uncontested Borders
readings.subtitle: Diligent obedience to the Torah guarantees the physical expulsion of adversarial nations and absolute territorial security.
readings.text: [22] For if you diligently guard <dn>את</dn> all these commands which I command you, to do it, to love <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, to walk in all <dn>His</dn> ways, and to cling to <dn>Him</dn>, [23] then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall drive out all these nations before you, and you shall dispossess greater and stronger nations than you. [24] Every place on which the sole of your foot treads is yours: from the wilderness, and Leḇanon, from the river, the River Euphrates, even to the Western Sea is your border. [25] No man shall stand against you. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> shall put <dn>את</dn> the dread of you and <dn>את</dn> the fear of you upon all the land where you tread, as <dn>He</dn> has spoken to you.

readings.title: The Binary Choice at Gerizim and Ěyḇal
readings.subtitle: Moses sets forth the definitive realities of absolute blessing for obedience and structural ruin for rebellion.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 11:26] See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse: [27] <dn>את</dn> the blessing, when you obey the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which I command you today; [28] and <dn>את</dn> the curse, if you do not obey the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, but turn aside from the way which I command you today, to go after other mighty ones which you have not known. [29] And it shall be, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has brought you into the land which you go to possess, that you shall put <dn>את</dn> the blessing on Mount Gerizim and <dn>את</dn> the curse on Mount Ěyḇal. [30] Are they not beyond the Yarděn, toward the setting sun, in the land of the Kena‛anites who dwell in the desert plain opposite Gilgal, beside the terebinth trees of Moreh? [31] For you are passing over the Yarděn to go in to possess <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it, [32] and shall guard to do all the laws and right-rulings which I am setting before you today.’

readings.title: Obliterating the Traces of Pagan Worship
readings.subtitle: A strict mandate to dismantle and burn all adversarial infrastructure and high places prior to establishing YeHoVaH's worship.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 12:1] “These are the laws and right-rulings which you guard to do in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of your fathers is giving you to possess, all the days that you live on the soil. [2] "Completely destroy all the places where the nations which you are dispossessing served their mighty ones, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree. [3] “And you shall break down their slaughter-places, and smash their pillars, and burn their Ashěrim with fire. And you shall cut down the carved images of their mighty ones and shall destroy <dn>את</dn> their name out of that place. [4] “Do not do so to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>,

readings.title: The Exclusive Dwelling Place
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH mandates a singular, centralized location for His Name, completely rejecting decentralized, subjective worship.
readings.text: [5] but seek <dn>את</dn> the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses, out of all your tribes, to put <dn>His</dn> Name there, for <dn>His</dn> Dwelling Place, and there you shall enter. [6] “And there you shall take your ascending offerings, and your slaughters, and your tithes, and the contributions of your hand, and your vowed offerings, and your voluntary offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock. [7] “And there you shall eat before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has blessed you.

readings.title: Establishing Order in the Inheritance
readings.subtitle: A prohibition against individualistic practices, anticipating the systematic order and rest to be established in the land.
readings.text: [8] “Do not do as we are doing here today – each one doing whatever is right in his own eyes. [9] “Because you have not yet entered the rest and the inheritance which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you. [10] “But you shall pass over the Yarděn, and shall dwell in the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you to inherit, and <dn>He</dn> shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and you shall dwell in safety. [11] “And it shall be, that unto the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses to make <dn>His</dn> Name dwell there, there you are to bring all that I command you: your ascending offerings, and your slaughters, and your tithes, and the contributions of your hand, and all your choice offerings which you vow to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [12] “And you shall rejoice before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, you and your sons and your daughters, and your male servants and your female servants, and the Lěvite who is within your gates, since he has no portion nor inheritance with you. [13] “Guard yourself that you do not offer your ascending offerings in every place that you see, [14] except in the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses, in one of your tribes, there you are to offer your ascending offerings, and there you are to do all that I command you.

readings.title: Provisions for Meat and the Sanctity of Blood
readings.subtitle: Delineating the parameters for common slaughtering versus set-apart offerings, with an absolute prohibition on consuming the lifeblood.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 12:15] “Only, whatever your being desires you shall slaughter and eat, according to the blessing of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which <dn>He</dn> has given you, within all your gates. The unclean and the clean do eat of it, of the gazelle and the deer alike. [16] “Only, <dn>את</dn> the blood you do not eat, pour it on the earth like water. [17] “You are not allowed to eat within your gates <dn>את</dn> the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or of the firstlings of your herd or your flock, or of any of your offerings which you vow, or of your voluntary offerings, or of the contribution of your hand. [18] “But eat them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, in the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses, you and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and the Lěvite who is within your gates. And you shall rejoice before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> in all that you put your hands to. [19] “Guard yourself that you do not forsake <dn>את</dn> the Lěvite as long as you live in your land.

readings.title: Managing Distance and the Ascending Offerings
readings.subtitle: Practical rules for honoring YeHoVaH's offerings when the geopolitical borders expand, ensuring perpetual compliance.
readings.text: [20] “When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> enlarges your border as <dn>He</dn> has promised you, and you say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because you long to eat meat, you eat as much meat as your being desires. [21] “When the place where <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> chooses to put <dn>His</dn> Name is too far from you, then you shall slaughter from your herd and from your flock which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat within your gates as much as your being desires. [22] “Only, as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you are to eat of it. The unclean and the clean alike eat of it. [23] “Only, be strong not to eat <dn>את</dn> the blood, for the blood is the life, do not eat <dn>את</dn> the life with the meat. [24] “Do not eat it, you pour it on the earth like water. [25] “Do not eat it, that it might be well with you and your children after you, when you do what is right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [26] “Only, <dn>את</dn> the set-apart gifts which you have, and your vowed offerings, you are to take up and go to the place which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses. [27] “And you shall make your ascending offerings, the meat and the blood, on the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. And the blood of your slaughterings is poured out on the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and you eat <dn>את</dn> the meat. [28] “Guard, and obey all these words which I command you, that it might be well with you and your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: The Rejection of Babylon and Abomination
readings.subtitle: A terminal warning against adopting the destructive, adversarial practices of the dispossessed nations into the worship of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 12:29] “When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> does cut off from before you <dn>את</dn> the nations which you go to dispossess, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land, [30] guard yourself that you are not ensnared to follow them, after they are destroyed from before you, and that you do not inquire about their mighty ones, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their mighty ones? And let me do so too.’ [31] “Do not do so to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, for every abomination which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> hates they have done to their mighty ones, for they even burn their sons and daughters in the fire to their mighty ones. [32] “All the words I am commanding you, guard to do it – do not add to it nor take away from it.
